name: Cart Convoy
design_intent:
TRIALS COLLECT_ALL proof course #2 -- the ROUTE-UNDER-MOTION collect (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.5; escalates past t_token_dash by adding a moving waypoint + fuel management). Grab all 6 tokens strung across a WIDE void between two far trampoline pads (x340..2500 = 2160px). Mid-void footing is ONLY a single small static trampoline island (x1360..1560) plus a moving flatbed CART (the flatbed_cart.png moving_platform, vehicle skin) that shuttles above it -- both TRAMPOLINE-tier bounce/refuel waypoints. The route: fly out over the void, bounce on the island (or the moving cart) to refuel + relaunch, boost UP off it to thread the high central token, and cross to the far pad. A fall respawns at start_gate (+2s). Clear-test = every group 'trials_pickup' member latched `collected`.

MOVEMENT-TOOL / FLIGHT-REQUIRED + FUEL (Rule A): a full tank (~3.5s boost ~= 2660px) cannot cross the 2160px void AND gain token height in one go, so you MUST fly AND refuel at the mid-void island/cart. Every token (x620..2420, y600-860) hangs over open void -- there is NO bounce route to them; a bounce dies in the void. The two crossing legs (left pad->island ~1020px, island->right pad ~1040px) each far exceed a bounce's reach (spring apex 480px), so BOOST is mandatory on each leg; the mid-void refuel is what makes the second leg fuel-possible. The high central token (1420,600) needs a boost UP off the island/cart (480px over the island top) -- the cart at y740 is the higher launch point for it. Vertical AND horizontal distance are both load-bearing.

CART: TRAMPOLINE-tier vehicle deck w400, center x1420 y740, axis horizontal, amplitude 400 (travels x1020..1820), period 7.0s, dwell 0.15. Bouncing on it refuels (fuel_per_bounce 20) and relaunches you higher than the island; a rider flung high flies free. NOT a hazard -- the void/fall is the only killer.

MEDAL (time, faster better): a routed run threads 6 tokens in ~14-22s (timing the moving cart's bounce costs time vs token_dash's static line). gold 15.0 / silver 24.0 / bronze 42.0. FLAG: medal times need a movement-bot tuning pass.
